course.title: Engineering Construction Management
course.department: Department of Building Engineering and Construction Management

content.value: A.design build operate engineering company in Texas that owns a sizable amount of land plans to lease the drilling rights (oil and gas only) to a mining and exploration company. The contract calls for the mining company to pay \$ 15,000 per year for 20 years beginning 3 years from now (i.e. beginning at the end of year 3 and continuing through year 22) plus \$ 8,000 six years from now and \$ 12,000 sixteen years from now. Utilize engineering economy relations to determine the five equivalent values listed below at 15% per year.
